name: Powermatrix
description: This superpower provides you an extremely cool, awesome, original, indestructible, and comfortable gauntlet. Which grants you complete & utter access, use, and information of all your superhuman powers & abilities via hardlight holographic displays. That also allows you to organize all of the superhuman powers & abilities that you possess. The gauntlet itself can become invisible and intangible when every you want. And is powered by an infinite & unlimited clean, safe, and efficient power supply
summary: The ability to have an indestructible gauntlet that provides you access to all your superhuman powers and abilities
strengths: A gauntlet that allows you at access and utilize all of your superhuman powers and abilities.
Able to view information about your superhuman powers and abilities and organize them as well.
The Gauntlet is powered by an infinite & unlimited clean, safe, and efficient power supply.
weaknesses: Does not provide you any superpowers, only the ability to access and utilize the ones you have.
The gauntlet can not be removed unless you are dead or your arm is removed.

name: Invisibility
description: Everyone knows this one.  You can become transparent so that people see right through you.  Be careful though--people can still run into you and getting covered in flour or any other dust gives you away.
summary: The ability to become invisible to the naked eye.
strengths: Sneak into places
Locker rooms with hotties
Become a badass spy
weaknesses: Getting run over by a truck
Locker rooms with old wrinkly people
Getting caught

name: The Shadow Dragon
description: A person can control physical darkness and shadows, but this power is not at all evil. The person simply uses their mind to control it, and can become a powerful Shadow Dragon, similar in appearance to a Night Fury, with powers over a black fire that only they, or whom they choose, is immune to, and they can also use the fire to fully heal themselves or others. They can use the black fire in human form, are immortal, and have invisibility just like Peter Petrelli, but it blocks sound and heat.
summary: The ability to have all the powers over shadows and darkness
strengths: The powers of the Shadow Dragon can be used in human form, and are augmented by moonlight
You have extremely powerful 'black pyrokinesis', regeneration, invisibility, and vector telekinesis
They can easily overpower even the strongest light, manmade or natural, except for the sun
weaknesses: The sun is the only source they are powerless against
The shifting of human to dragon, and use of the powers, only works at night
Prolonged exposure to light stronger than the moon, if using the powers, weakens the user

name: Shadow Clone Technique
description: Always wanted to watch movies and play video games at the same time? Well now you can! With this ability you can split yourself in two. If you possess more than one superpower they will be split amongst the clones and if you only have one, the power will get weaker as it's potency will be split into the clones. The power of this ability is based on the creativity of the user, example he can use a clone to throw him in the air.
summary: The ability to create clones of yourself by splitting your powers in two
strengths: Can distract foes by attacking from all directions at once
Can be very useful for spying as when they are unsummoned all information comes back to the user
weaknesses: Superpowers are split amongst the clones and/or are weakened by them
Takes a lot of willpower to make more clones
Clones can be destroyed with one good hit

name: Darkness Manipulation
description: A user of this superpower can do the exact opposite of someone with Photo-Kinesis; they can decrease the amount of light and create 'flashes' of total darkness. They can also cloak themselves to hide during the night and can become completely invisible when in shadows. An adept user would be able to 'melt' into the shadows and could travel between them easily. An extremely adept user would be able to create the illusion of the Sun dimming in the sky by creating a planet-wide veil of darkness.
summary: The ability to manipulate darkness and shadows
strengths: You can avoid detection by manipulating shadows.
It can be used without other weaponry.
You can play upon human's natural fear of the dark.
weaknesses: This can be cancelled out by someone with Photo-Kinesis.
More advanced aspects require a large amount of mental strength.
Extreme aspects could lead to madness and insanity.

name: Shadow Speed
description: It is best used at night or in a forest where shadows or darkness are predominate. While in shadows/darkness you have the ability of super speed.
summary: The ability to able to move exceedingly fast within shadows
strengths: If your wearing black you're almost invisible
Can attack without being seen due to the stealth of the shadows/darkness
Great move for ninjas (let's face it who doesn't like ninjas)
weaknesses: Does not work in light, only in shadows

name: Reflective Invisibility
description: This is a very interesting power to have. A person can turn themselves invisible, either partially or completely, by touching a mirror. The light around the person will be absorbed into their reflection, turning it into a shadow, but their real body will disappear. The person can still interact normally with objects, but people won't know they are there until the power is deactivated. This form of invisibility is exactly like Peter Petrelli's, but sound and thermal detection are impossible.
summary: The ability to turn yourself invisible by touching a mirror
strengths: Sneak up on enemies totally undetected!!
Works both day and night!
Scare people with a sinister shadow reflection!
weaknesses: Cannot work with broken mirrors or pocket mirrors.
Can be weakened by both sunlight, and by electricity over 200 volts.
You are not invisible to others who have this power, or any light-based power.

name: Ghost Field
description: Make portable and movable fields that make things intangible for however long you want. Make a field around a bullet so it can go through walls or innocent people and become tangible right before hitting your opponent. Make a field around yourself in a sphere to protect you from any physical harm, or make a skin-tight field around yourself to phase through walls, people, weapons, or objects. When phasing objects become invisible, so you could phase into a tree and make a little peephole.
summary: The ability to make fields of intangibility
strengths: Be immune to physical harm
Hide easily
Don't need to hurt innocents or go around walls
weaknesses: Can't go through force fields
Energy weapons
Non-physical superpowers

name: Thief's Power
description: This power makes you ambidexterous to steal or pick pockets in most positions. You gain an innate knowledge of parkour and karate to fight out of situations. To sneak in and out of art museums you gain invisibility that is voluntary and your sense of balance is doubled so that you can evade security cameras. This power also allows you to know what elements, such as gold, something is made of to tell how much it's worth. Finally, you have eternal youth to continue stealing valuable objects.
summary: The ability to become an expert thief.
strengths: Get rich easily.
Almost impossible to get caught.
You become excellent with knives and throwing stars.
weaknesses: Eternal youth doesn't help against bullets.
People will hate you.

name: Stealth Deception
description: Never fail again. Aquire infinite knowledge about any subject at will.
summary: The ability to cheat on any contest without the possibilty of being caught
strengths: Always win intellectual conflicts
Never get caught
weaknesses: Must use a broad topic or will not get what you want
Will erupt in flames if you lose any contest. (including sports)

name: Stealth
description: A person with Stealth is security's worst nightmare. With active concentration, they can become totally silent and partially invisible. This partial invisibility means that from a distance, they resemble a darkish blob. Even up close, facial features are obscured. However, the user is not totally invisible--they must still use cover if in an exposed place. The silent aura that surrounds a Stealthy person hides all the sounds of motion and reduces a gunshot to a mere coughing noise.
summary: The ability to become partially invisible and partially silent
strengths: Sneaking around
Partial silence can bring a gunshot down to a cough
Partial invisiblity obscures body shape at a distance
weaknesses: Can still be hurt
Not totally silent
Not totally invisible

name: Event Cloak
description: Unlike classic invisibility cloaks, which bend light around an object, an event cloak would open up a time gap in the light by slowing its speed, and then sealing it again to hide all traces of activity within the gap. It works like crossing a special highway where some cars slow down, creating a jaywalker-friendly, vehicle-free gap, before speeding up again to re-establish the seamless flow of traffic. Event cloaking would allow you to do pretty much anything without anyone knowing.
summary: The ability to create a time gap within light
strengths: Rob a bank in broad daylight becaue no one can see you, or any of your actions for that matter
No one can prove you ate the last cookie
Security cameras are useless since you and anything you do is hidden within the light
weaknesses: Motion sensors
You can still make noise, so it's best to do things quietly

name: Invisibility Bestowal
description: You can turn just about anything temporarily invisible by touching them and willing it. Of course, you can turn yourself invisible too by willing yourself invisible. You are able to see the things that are turned invisible; not only the things you turned invisible, but also those done by others.
summary: The ability to turn things invisible.
strengths: Practical jokes: "He touched my hair and now I'm bald!"
Turn foe's gadgets invisible. Especially effective against Batman.
Turn teammates invisible.
weaknesses: You'd be the one suspected whenever something's missing.

name: Shadow Mimicry
description: A person with Shadow Mimicry has an amazing gift. They can turn their bodily tissues into a living shadow. This allows them to move swiftly and silently along walls and floors, become unable to be touched, and even detach themselves from the wall and stretch like a shadow. However, there are some issues. The user must remain attached to a wall or floor when detaching themselves, gets more obvious in the day, and when there is zero light dies. Every shadow needs light.
summary: The ability to become a shadow
strengths: Swift silent motion
Spy extraordinaire
Can stretch from wall and fight
weaknesses: Can be noticed
Die in zero light (every shadow needs light)
Need a wall or floor

name: Electromagnetic Kinesis
description: Can manipulate the electromagnetic spectrum, in all of it's intensity, from gamma rays to x-rays.
summary: The ability to control the electromagnetic spectrum.
strengths: Become Invisible with light spectrum manipulation.
Controlling Microwaves causes melting, boiling and burning.
Get a tan easily with UV rays
weaknesses: May emit radiation, causing cancer
Very hard to control - would definitly draw attention.
Must study Physics closley to fully understand your power.

name: Shadow
description: The ability to "disappear" into any shadow, and move about within the world as a shadow. Whilst inside shadows, you have the ability to reappear from any point within it, effectively teleporting, and becoming invisible whilst within the shadow. If the shadow is destroyed, by being washed out with a light source, you will be "forced" out of the shadow and re-enter the regular world.
summary: The ability to merge with Shadows
strengths: Fast movement through shadows.
Stealth movement abilities.
While in the shadows you cannot be hurt.
weaknesses: If the shadow disappears, you will be forced to re-appear.
Can only move around within the shadows you entered as you cannot jump between shadows.
Without any shadows nearby, you are helpless. you cannot enter your own shadow.

name: Shadow Animation
description: This is the ability to animate one's shadow, allowing it to become a "living" three-dimensional being capable of flattening up against walls, impersonating the shadows of others, merging with the user (allowing him to become invisible in shadows and teleport through them) or aligning themselves to another person, allowing the user to see the target wherever he goes, through the shadow (like a scrying device)
summary: The ability to bring one's shadow to life for various purposes
strengths: Finally your lazy shadow picks up some of the slack
Become invisible in shadows
Teleport through shadows
weaknesses: Intense light
Umbrakinetic psychics can take control of your shadow, too
If your shadow has a mind of it's own (and isn't mentally connected to you) once you animate it

name: Shadow Obliteration
description: One with this ability is powerful to say the least. In most cases, a shadow disappears when there is no way for the shadow to be made; however, one with this ability reverses this relation on a quantum level. They psychically cause matter to disappear whenever the matter's shadow disappears. However, this isn't always active. The user psychically deletes the shadow (or makes it invisible) which in turn makes the object that makes the shadow disappear.
summary: The ability to delete a person from existence by deleting their shadow
strengths: Works on anything, living, dead or inanimate (as long as it casts a shadow)
Doesn't activate automatically (no accidental obliteration)
Doesn't require much concentration
weaknesses: May require touch
Umbrakinetics can secure their shadows
If your powers are uncontrolled, they might delete people or things accidentally

name: Sticking To The Shadows
description: This power allows you to make shadows take on the properties and consistency of a sticky adhesive, such as tar or rubber cement, impeding or trapping anything that touches them. This power does not apply to the darkness of nighttime, but specifically for shadows caused by a light source.
summary: The ability to make shadows sticky.
strengths: Get things stuck in shadows.
weaknesses: Does not work with the absence of light, only with shadows caused by light.

name: Starlight Camouflage
description: At night when the stars are shining, whether there is cloud cover or not, you gain complete invisibility. Your senses are heightened and you gain increased athletic abilities.
summary: The ability to be invisible at night
strengths: Invisible if the stars are shining
Can be a ninja
Get extra sensory powers
weaknesses: Uncontrolable
Cannot be seen even indoors
Cannot see yourself

name: Intraceability
description: When you walk, you leave no footprints. Items left behind are free of scent or identification (such as a name or address); it is much like invisibility where a person cannot be seen, but in this case the person cannot be followed by the use of evidence left behind. However, they still can be recognized by a witness and found by what the witness said. The intraceability doesn't activate until the person leaves the scene (or as long as they are standing in one spot they have a footprint).
summary: The ability to leave nothing behind that would allow anyone or anything to follow you.
strengths: Cannot be followed via tracking (prints, markings, scents, IDs)
Throw a party and trash the place, then leave and it's like you were never there.
As long as you keep distance, your enemies will never catch you
weaknesses: Cannot use markings to find your way back
Still visible and thus can be recognized by witnesses
No one can find you by tracking, including those who can help you.

name: Invisible In The Shadows
description: This power allows you to become invisible when you are standing in shadows or darkness. You control when you become invisible and at night you can be practically invisible anywhere.
summary: The ability to become invisible in the presence of shadows and darkness
strengths: you can be invisible
good for sneaking up on people
good for being an assassin
weaknesses: only works with shadows or darkness near you
once you run out of shadow you can't go anywhere
tags: invisible in the shadows or darkness

name: Total Silence
description: Are you terrible at sneaking about because you are a loud person? With Total Silence, no one will hear you, even if you are scratching chalkboards along the way!   WARNING: Scratching chalkboards is not recommended because, as the user of this ability, you could still hear them.
summary: The ability to be unheard in any action you take.
strengths: You can be loud and destructive while still maintaining steath!
You can shout insults at people without them taking notice.
weaknesses: People can still see you, so don't get too crazy.

name: Shadow Claws
description: You can turn your hands into shadow claws that can penetrate almost any substance or material.
summary: The ability to make your hands become shadow claws
strengths: It is good for fights
The claws can come out at will
weaknesses: It might put someone in the hospital

name: Shadow Watch
description: Any shadow that is cast you will be able to spy through from shadow you are near. Eavesdrop on people from the shadows. You do have to picture either the person or area you want to look at & the closest shadow maybe to small to view through.
summary: The ability to use shadows as windows to look through
strengths: Shadows are your windows
weaknesses: You have to imagine what person or area you want to view
The shadows may not have a great view

name: Control Shadow
description: The shadow ring has the ability to call shadow beasts by saying :Let there be darkness, with the ring you can control shadow beasts and help you in your combats.
summary: The ability to call shadows with your ring of darkness
strengths: You don't need to be in a shadow
The opponent can't cut it nor shoot it
It can only be attacked with psychic powers or the ring of light
weaknesses: You can only call two-three beasts at a time
It can beaten with the ring of light or with a magical attack
You need to be in darkness to operate it

name: Camouflage
description: You can change the coloration of objects to make them harder to see. For example: change the color of your skin and clothing to blend into the forest. You can change the coloration/texture of any surface, by either touching or looking at it, with the application of the camouflage in mind. If you wanted to hide in the forest, think "forest", and the object you are touching/concentrating on will change color and/or texture instantly. This also allows you to create fake models of things to hide in.
summary: The ability to make anything imperceptible
strengths: Can mock up hollow rocks or dead tree stumps to hide in
Can hide anywhere at any time
Works on other people, and happens naturally when sleeping
weaknesses: Can't hurt enemies with it
Doesn't make you invisible, just really hard to see
Won't work if you don't know what environment you're in, or if you are in an empty room/box

name: Shadow Combination
description: To attatch yourself with your own shadow, making yourself light, 2D, and invisible in other shadows.
summary: The ability to combine yourself with your own shadow
strengths: Can fly
Easily looked past
Can escape through cracks between doors
weaknesses: Cold - if done for too long will result in hypothermia
If you don't concentrate you will float away
Everything looks blurry and unfocused - hard to concentrate

name: True Intentions
description: Using this ability you can see the true intentions of someone. You can tell if someone is good or evil, but you can't tell the 'level' of good or evil someone is on. You will unconsciencly judge yourself. Also, there is no 'in the middle' because people who are like that are either good or evil and it is being hidden by other actions. (hoped that answered some questions)
summary: The ability to see if someone is good or evil
strengths: It's impossible to have bad friends, you could see if they were evil.
Comes in handy in political situations.
You see someones true nature and intentions.
weaknesses: People who know of your powers will most likely try to exploit you. (not always)
You become very self-conscious, due to the fact that this power makes you judge yourself.
Knowing that people you love are evil can be a big burden.

name: Shadow Absorption
description: Able to absorb someones shadow at will.  This renders the person who's shadow was absorbed dead.  A person's ability will automatically be gained when their shadow is absorbed.  People who possess this power are a threat to people who can mimic shadows.
summary: The ability to absorb shadows (and abilities)
strengths: Grow stronger with every shadow you absorb
Gain multiple abilities
weaknesses: You can kill people close to you

name: Delete This Cryptokinesis
description: combo of powers.
summary: The ability to render objects unseen.
strengths: Invisiblity
Can make other things invisble too.
weaknesses: requires touch

name: Chameleon
description: Like a chameleon, you'll have a perfect camouflage. You'll be able to blend in a fade into your surroundings. Though its not quite true invisibility, but its close. Also have to concentrate to keep hidden, especially when moving at a fast pace.
summary: The ability to camouflage & blend into to the surroundings
strengths: Perfect camouflage
weaknesses: Not true invisibility
Have to focus hard when moving quickly

name: Residence Protection
description: With this ability, you can make a buildin unable to be entered except by yourself, owner/s of the house or those invited by the owner. In addition, uninvited people cannot use powers on the building or anything inside it. This protection lasts as long as it remains a residential building, someone is in it and you are alive. This means they could control you to let them inside.
summary: The ability to keep uninvited people out of a residential building.
strengths: Have a safe house for you and your allies.
Uninvited people cannot use powers on the inside of the building.
Only the building owners and those given the right can invite people.
weaknesses: There are many things which count as an invite.
Uninvited people can force the owner to give them access.
Someone needs to be inside, it cannot be converted and you must stay alive.

name: Breath Of Cold
description: Irradiate a frigid mist or fog that extends from your body to what ever point in a room you want. You can move within the mist silently and swiftly like a ghost or phantom. Pull people in and out of the mist at will.  With experience speed of invisibility increases creating the illusion of desintergration.
summary: The ability to emit a cold mist or fog to create the illussion of being invisible
strengths: Create dramatic escapes Ex: out of that math final you didnt study for ;)
Appear as a ghost and scare people into doing anything you want
You can make other people or objects invisible also
weaknesses: Depending on your emotional state the temperature could drop dramatically fast
Mist goes a maximum of only 20ft
Until full control your hands become abnormally cold and breath appears chilled

name: Shadow Puppets
description: With this ability, you can take control over another person's shadow, essentially controlling them in the process. It does take a lot of focus though to control it and if the shadow disappears, the power over the person is broken.
summary: The ability to control other people's shadow.
strengths: Essentially controlling a person via their shadow.
weaknesses: It takes concentration to control them.
If the shadow disappears, the link to the person is broken.

name: Master Mime
description: Whatever you want to mime will become real, but invisible to other people.  They will not be able to see the mimed objects, but they will still be able to feel and be affected by them.
summary: The ability to mime objects that become real.
strengths: Miming a box around your stuff
Mime a gun and shoot someone
Mime money to trick vending machines
weaknesses: Walking into invisible walls
You couldn't actually be a mime
Your superhero name would suck

name: Summon Ninjas
description: A person with this power has the ability to summon generic superninjas. The ninjas are at your beck and call. The ninjas have the typical ninja moveset of generic ninjas in fiction. They can teleport, hide in small places, have limited superstrength, and can literally walk on air. They also have ninja weapons. They will do whatever the summoner asks them to do. You can use them as messengers, foot soldiers, as well as send them to buy your groceries. They can communicate with you telepathically.
summary: The ability to summon ninjas to do your bidding
strengths: You can summon as many as you want and you can also unsummon them
They are all skilled and have the typical ninja moveset
You control them and they understand what you say(no communication error)
weaknesses: They will tend to kill people in the way of your orders
They will also attack pirates or people with eyepatches for no particular reason
They can't communicate with other people unless you give them a note

name: Lodekrio
description: Anything you touch, you may become. You may become a car, or a building. If you wish, you may even be your cousin, the guy down the street, the president, even.
summary: The ability to become anything you touch, organic or inorganic
strengths: Become anyone, anything
Master of disguise
If you're touching two things at once, you may choose which to be
weaknesses: No body of your own
Kill innocent people, if you becomes too big of an item/animal

name: Hide In Plain Sight
description: A person with this power produces no trace. A scent dog cannot find them because this power erases the user's scent while it is active. This power also makes the user totally silent. However, the user of this power is not totally invisible. They can be seen but they are translucent. This power can be turned on and off easily and has very little effect on the user physically.
summary: The ability to be undetectable
strengths: Escape from scent dogs
Be a super ninja
Make wolverine and run. Even he won't be able to pick up your scent
weaknesses: Not invisible
Doesn't have any offensive uses
Once you turn the power off, you start producing a scent again

name: Shadowing
description: You can create an almost invisible being that follows a person around (until you tell it not to, in which case it fades away) and feeds you information about that particular person. It can also assess that person's weaknesses, strengths and powers, as well as useful strategies. This being can only be seen in daylight (as a shadow), and if somebody notices it, not only can they not get rid of it, it will also make them paranoid.
summary: The ability to create a being to follow and observe someone
strengths: Can drive a person insane
Learn plans and spy on your enemies
Gives you a full readout on the person
weaknesses: A person with true sight can see it
It can only inform you about the person you sent it after
Takes time to gather the information

name: Searchlight Eyes
description: If you have this kind of power it means you never have to move to find anything because you can just use your powers to see where what you're looking for is and to see if it is inside your stuff. When you're robbing stuff, you don't have to worry about things you can't see because of your power.
summary: The ability to see through things, to look for something from very far, far, far away, and to see invisible things.
strengths: Easy to look out for invisible fighters, warriors, or cops
You can see what's far, far, far away and can see if something or somebody is looking for you
You can hide while looking where somebody is going at the same time
weaknesses: Well that's all you can do... that's it.
After five hours from using it, you'll get a major headache.

name: Awesome
description: You are incredibly awesome. This is a subconscious reality warping ability. Normally, probability is altered so things just go really great for you, though physics can also be distorted so things like action-movie cliches are possible. Your intelligence is enhanced, and you can gain general knowledge or a rare specific detail (disguised as a hidden moment of inspiration) for fighting and any skills (such as musical instruments or games), and one-liners. You will be in peak physical condition.
summary: The ability to be extremely awesome
strengths: Never need to buy weapons, sunglasses, or cool-looking clothes
You can live like an action movie star, or just be awesome at anything
weaknesses: Sound like you're really stuck up describing your power ("My power is that I am amazingly awesome...
... No, like, its actually a power.  ")
Not extremely powerful

name: Negate
description: You're surrounded by an invisible force that causes the powers of others to disappear as long as they're near you. With enough concentration, you can materialize this invisible force and use it as a dagger. Any superpowered beings who are wounded by this dagger will permanently lose their powers. Any ordinary people wounded by the materialized neutralizing force will bleed non-stop.
summary: The ability to neutralize any superpowers
strengths: Secured while surrounded by supernatural beings
Disables your enemy's superpowers
weaknesses: You might wound yourself

name: Broken Invisibility
description: With this power you can turn things or people invisible as long as you're holding part of it in your hands. For instance you can make your car or vehicle invisible just by holding the steering wheel or any other part of it. You can make somebody invisible if you're holding their hand or something. The part that you're holding doesn't even need to be attached to the object as long as it originally came from it. You cannot use this power on yourself but it can be used on you by others.
summary: The ability to make something invisible as long as you're holding a piece of it
strengths: You can turn things invisible just by holding part of them
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Censorship
description: You can cover any object with a black box that is impossible to see through or replace any word about to be said with a bleep sound. Don't want people to see that hideous mole? They'll see a black box instead with this power.
summary: The ability to censor objects and sounds in real life like on TV.
strengths: Great for censoring out things that shouldn't be seen or sounds that shouldn't be heard.
Be a real troll with this power.
weaknesses: Doesn't censor smell, touch or taste.
Could be considered to be a pretty annoying person with this power.
It's obvious you're hiding something when there's a big black box in the way.

name: Intonation Manipulation
description: The overview pretty much says it all. With this superpower you are the master of accents. You can put on any accent you choose and it's 100% authentic. French, Irish, Italian it's a piece of cake for you! However, you can only speak English with your chosen accent. The power doesn't work on other languages.
summary: The ability to master every single accent that exists
strengths: You can disguise yourself pretty well
Great for practical jokes
No one knows what nationality you're from
weaknesses: People might get annoyed if you constantly switch accents

name: Reaper Shadow
description: With this power you can transform your shadow into a real reaper to do your bidding and as your shadow it will be entirely loyal to you. Since reapers are invisible to normal people you can kill invisibly, only you and others with this power can see it. They are not affected by light but also not invincible, so can be defeated by other reaper shadows. The reaper will express your personality so will be unique but maybe won't wield a scythe, also as long as it is summoned you won't have a shadow.
summary: The ability to transform your shadow into a reaper
strengths: Get revenge on anyone
Become a great assassin
Always have a friend by your side
weaknesses: Will have no shadow while summoned so can be spotted by someone aware
Your reaper might not wield a scythe instead wielding another weapon like a dagger

name: Item Possession
description: The ability to take over anything that's not already alive. The only real limit is that it has to be one unit.  You can't get a whole train, but one car. The different parts of the objects are opposable, and when what you're in breaks, you pop out. You still feel some pain, but it is lessened.
summary: The ability to possess inanimate objects
strengths: Be a beast at hide and go seek
Easy way to turn a getaway car into a trap
weaknesses: Useless in areas without obects

name: Truth Serum
description: This power makes a person tell the honest truth. You touch the person & a psychoactive drug is injected into their blood stream that makes them lose some inhibitions, mostly the part of lying & being silent. So they start rambling on about everything they know & believe is true. It's a fast acting chemical that wears off after a day. Plus, it makes them dehydrated from non-stop talking & hyperactive & restless, so they'll crash after the drug is out of their system.
summary: The ability to induce a truth telling chemical into a person
strengths: You'll hear the truth, the whole, truth & nothing but the truth
weaknesses: They endlessly babble on
What they believe is true could be false information
Wears off after a day & they become dehydrated & lethargic

name: Nightfall
description: This is the ability to generate an aura of psionic darkness around oneself. This aura of darkness makes the area around it look like it would at night (hence the name), and psionically blinds everybody in the field, along with making anyone within the aura/field appear invisible to anyone outside of the aura/field. Not to mention, this aura also protects the user and anyone else within the field from intense light, as the field absorbs all ambient light within a certain radius.
summary: The ability to produce an aura that produces various night/dark related effects
strengths: You can see within the aura
Foes can't see within the aura
If you have another power like lycanthropy or invisibility in darkness, it's activated
weaknesses: If you suck and can't see in your own aura
If your loved ones can't see in the aura
People can see you coming (a big radius of darkness surrounds you)

name: Mask
description: With this power you call for a mask to hide your appearance. The mask is not like a normal mask. This mask dos not come off unless you take it off. The mask will hide your appearance from your enemies & they will not be able to take it off or force you to take off. You must want to take it off and be safe to take it off.
summary: The ability to call for a mask that can hide your appearance.
strengths: Mask will hide your appearance
Mask dos not come off unless you take it off
The mask will hide your appearance from your enemies
weaknesses: You have to want to take it off
You don't have any offensive power
You can be killed

name: Presence Projection
description: Annoyed that your friends and allies cannot see you while invisible? This is the power for you. You can project knowledge of your presence to targeted individuals, selected groups or those with a particular trait (e. G. A particular power).
summary: The ability to alert others of your presence.
strengths: Eliminate a problem with invisibility and other concealment powers.
Prevent others from being surprised by your presence on arrival.
Can be controlled easily and turned off at will.
weaknesses: Very limited usefulness, especially by itself.
While you may control this power, you may not control the powers it supports.
Immunity to telepathy will necessitate another mental communication power for this to function.

name: Cheshire Smile
description: First exhibited by the legendary Cheshire Cat, this ability allows the user to use his smile as a mode of defense or just amusement. In fact, the second the user cracks a smile, he can elect to become entirely intangible and/or entirely invisible (or mostly invisible, save one's eyes and smile); when the ability is in use, the user may also levitate and move through the air silently
summary: The ability to harness the mad charm of the Cheshire Cat
strengths: Disappear, turn intangible and turn inaudible at will
Levitate at will
Your smile finally has a use in a fight
weaknesses: Your smile may become a bit larger than normal when power first manifests
People think you're creepy if you keep popping up in strange places all the time
You may go a bit mad after too many uses of the power

name: Geoformation Mimicry
description: Geoformation or Geoform is short for Geometric Transformation. Basically, you can mimic anything that is based on translation, reflection, rotation, or dilation and the way it does it. I will give you an example: You can mimic the dilation of your shadow to big or small and can do it continuously.
summary: The ability to mimic anything that translates, reflects, rotates, or dilates.
strengths: Multiple variety of transformations.
weaknesses: The effects only lasts for 15-20 min.

name: Helmet Of Night
description: With this power, you call forth a helmet to manipulate and control the element of Shadow and Darkness. While wearing it, you can phase through objects, blind anyone you want, become invisible in the presence of darkness, manipulate shadows and darkness into solid objects or force fields, see clearly in the shadow and darkness, and see what shadows see. The Helmet cannot be lost as it will come all the way back to you. You are immune to the effects of Shadow and Darkness.
summary: The ability to call forth a helmet that can manipulate and control the element of Shadow and Darkness
strengths: With the Helmet, you are immune to the effects of Shadow and Darkness.
The Helmet cannot be lost as it will come back
The shadows will protect you
weaknesses: Light will weaken you
You must have the Helmet on for it to work.
People may fear you

name: Secret World Organization
description: You are the supreme boss of a secret organization that's spread all over your world.  As such you have control over it's vast resources and actions.  The organization possesses hidden research facilities, sleeper cells of trained operatives, shadow politicians, training facilities,...
summary: The ability to have complete control over a secret organization in your world
strengths: You can give missions to trained teams
You can have the research departments invent new weapons and tools
You can use the orginazation to influence politics while staying in obscurity
weaknesses: Keeping control over the organization can consume a lot of time and resources
Superheroes finding out and taking you down

name: Jibberish Comprehension
description: On the one hand, this power allows you to understand the meaning of any foreign language. On the other hand, it also allows you to understand any hidden messages contained within coded, cryptic, vague or badly worded messages, in-jokes, double entendres and even visual messages. This power is always active, so you automatically read or understand messages as what they are intended to mean or hide.
summary: The ability to automatically get the intended message behind what you would not normally understand.
strengths: You can understand what animals, babies, drunk guys, insane people and girls want.
You can understand the meaning of any hidden messages and codes.
You can understand the sense of any language, be it a computer, an alien or a sign language.
weaknesses: You just understand the meaning. You don't get the knowledge of how to code or speak the language.
You could get in trouble if you understand something that's supposed to be confidential.

name: Note Creation
description: You can create music anywhere you go and anyway you want. It can be people tripping simultaneously, or causing people to sip drinks, all in song. It can be any song (Ode To Joy, Happy Birthday,... ) Wherever you make the music, everything within a 50-meter radius becomes silent, so you can appreciate the music. You can do it anytime, but can only have one song before halting it. To make the music, you have to think about the song and scale (B flat) and then snap your fingers. Snap again to halt.
summary: The ability to create music anywhere, anyhow.
strengths: Be a music master.
Entertain your school and friends.
Make everyone applaud you.
weaknesses: People may think you're a freak.
May be a bad form of music (farting, burping).
Cannot merge songs.

name: Secret
description: The attributes of secrets can be very useful indeed. You can hide in plain sight or in shadows and other thiings with the effectivness of invisibility. You can be well protected from danger by barriers and other things. You can also be exempt from people scanning you to find things out about you and this includes intuitive aptitude. You can also gain a secret's trait of being important to be an automatic V. I. P.
summary: The ability to manipulate the attributes of secrets in yourself.
strengths: This power cannot be shortened to its breif description at the top.
This is good for being evasive.
A wide plethora of uses and pros cant be negated.
weaknesses: Can be blocked by power sacrifice.

name: Quartzling Spies
description: This power allows you to create small creatures from quartz with the purpose of discrete espionage. These creatures will function independently following your orders. They are able to project what they see back to you, giving you dozens of moving eyes that are difficult to destroy given how hard quartz is.
summary: The ability to generate quartz creatures to spy
strengths: Dozens of spies
Difficult to destroy
Independently operating
weaknesses: Quarts does not blend in to most enviornments

name: 4 D Field Generation
description: Mentally create an inverted forcefield around you that traps matter and hides yourself as a shadow on the ground.
summary: The ability to create a 4D area of space around you
strengths: Impervious to most attacks
Perfect camouflage
Excellent for trapping criminals
weaknesses: Matter is expelled after the field evaporates
Could take in far too much matter and create a black hole

name: Shut Up
description: Do your siblings ever bother you by just talking and talking and talking and talking? Not anymore! With Shut-up, you can make anybody be silent until you decide to make them talk again. But it can backfire by leaving everybody quiet for the rest of their lives, so you could go insane.
summary: The ability to make anybody (I repeat, anybody) shut up!
strengths: No more annoyances
Peace and quiet
weaknesses: If you use it too much at one time, it could backfire
You might go insane.

name: Gas Mimicry
description: Gas is something we all need--but if we breathe the wrong kind, it can kill us. A Gas Mimic can take on the properties of a gas at will, letting them float, become invisible, untouchable, and hide in small spaces. Their ability also allows them to take on the properties of specific gases, like chlorine gas, tear gas, or even nerve gas. However, they can be contained in airtight chambers, cannot pass through nonporous matter, and will be blown away in a stiff breeze.
summary: The ability to turn your body into various gases
strengths: Silent killer
Cannot be struck in gas form
Can choose which gas you want to be
weaknesses: Being blown away
Vacuum cleaners
Your flight is very slow

name: Ability Skill:Effect Reduction
description: It is what is said in the overview. You will barely feel the side effects of your abilities. This ability has a hidden effect as well. When you have an ability that gives side effects to someone else, those effects are also reduced.
summary: The ability to reduce any ability that has a side effect to little to no effect.
strengths: Will reduce effects of any kind caused by your own abilities.
Reduces side effects on other people.
Can choose which are reduced/negated and when.
weaknesses: None.

name: Trap Master
description: With this power you see the world as if on a grid. By selecting areas of the grid you can cause the area to be turned into a trap. The type of trap is typically random but you can direct the power to a certain type of trap, though it will not always turn out as you imagined. You can also direct the range of how deadly your trap is. You will not activate the trap but anyone else in the selected area will. The trap could be anything from a hidden turret to a disguised hole in the floor.
summary: The ability to create a trap in a selected area.
strengths: Set traps for your enemies using only your mind.
You are immune to your own traps.
You can deactivate your traps in the same way as making them.
weaknesses: Have to see the world in a grid all the time.
Your traps may not work as planned or hurt someone you wish to protect.
Foes have to come within the selected area for the trap to work.

name: Fog Shield
description: Your hands shake and a cloud of fog appears in which you can hide and strike unseen. The fog also functions as a shield against incoming attacks.
summary: The ability to create a thick fog.
strengths: A great way to escape stronger enemies.
You can hit unseen and retake a defensive position when the fog clears.
No human is able to see you in this thick fog.
weaknesses: Strong winds can blow away the fog and leave you defenseless.
Those with sonar and supersight will still be able to spot you.
It has no offensive possibilities.

name: Beneath Notice
description: Any being with super powers is completely incapable of acknowledging your existance in any way. They cannot see you, hear you, or divine you through any of their powers. If any super is told about you or learns about you in any way, they forget about you in seconds. This power is completely fool proof. If any power would allow a super to become aware of your existance, you are immune to that power. However, you can allow people to find you (like allies etc.)
summary: The ability to be compeletely imperceptable to anyone with super powers.
strengths: Immunity from any intentional super power
Sneak by even the most observant super undetected!
Can't be stopped by any super hero!
weaknesses: Can still be killed by supers accidentally
Never count on getting saved by a super hero
Normal people are unaffected

name: The Hungarian Mirror Trap
description: This ability is very useful. It can create passages into limbo through manipulation of ordinary mirrors, or create escape routes and hiding places. You simply place one hand flat on the mirror surface, and focus. It will instantly ripple and shimmer, thus changing the properties of the glass, and creating a liquid barrier to be entered and exited through. The person with the power is the only one who can control it. Enemies can be trapped forever. Small pocket mirrors can let you spy on enemies.
summary: The ability to control ordinary mirrors to become gateways into limbo
strengths: Trap enemies in an endless 'mirror world' similar to the 'House of Mirrors' from Samuel's carnival
Use the mirrors to hide and/or escape from enemies, and use small mirrors to spy on them
You, and anyone else chosen by you, can know their way through the trap
weaknesses: Small mirrors such as pocket mirrors and shaving mirrors don't work for travel
Broken mirrors can trap you for a long period of time, unless you focus hard enough to reform it
Travelling through a broken or cracked mirror can be extremely difficult, but not impossible

name: Plan B
description: Whenever happens if plan a failed and it doesen't work out right, then move on forward to Plan B. It'll grant you to do most powerful things like spying on villain hideouts, choose a diferent offensive and/or defensive ability, or try to warn a team member of upcoming impending danger.
summary: The ability to switch to a second option in case the other one doesn't work out.
strengths: Plan B might work after all.
weaknesses: If Plan B doesen't work then go to other plans.

name: Myth Power: Dolos' Deal
description: Dolos (Dolus), in Greek mythology, was the god of cleverness, cunning, guile and trickery. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in how to speak and act to trick and con others. In addition, one becomes highly agile and dexterous, gaining skill in stealth, sleight of hand, pickpocketing, picking locks, cracking safes and other sneaky pursuits. Furthermore, one's voice can be used to cast illusions so subjects believe anything one says. One can even literally turn insults back on foes.
summary: The ability to channel Dolos' command over the essence of cleverness, craftiness, cunning and guile
strengths: Gain superhuman skill in tricking and conning others
Become highly agile and dexterous, gain skill in stealth, sleight of hand, pickpocketing, etc
Cast illusions by voice (subjects believe anything one says); turn foes' insults back on them
weaknesses: Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel tricksters/thieves/con artists when developed
Only gain the power of Crocodile Tears and (eventually) Mirage Inducing at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aletheia's Absolute and MythPower: Prometheus' Plan provide immunity (NCN)

name: Shadow Immunity
description: Powers that would directly affect your shadow will no longer affect it. EG. Shadow Obliteration or Shadow Manipulation if it is used on your shadow.
summary: The ability to be immune to shadow-based powers affecting one directly
strengths: You can't be erased from existence by Shadow Obliteration anymore.
weaknesses: They can still affect shadows in the environment to indirectly affect you.

name: Quoth The Raven, Nevermore
description: With this ability, you can summon to your side the Raven himself. A shadowy, spectral bird, he goes by Nevermore, and will only answer to that name. He can speak, and will happily carry out any task that you ask of him (in the bird's capability), including spying and revealing cryptic knowledge. He is immortal, and can return from being banished or "killed" at will, so once you summon him, he's there to stay (although, he doesn't eat, sleep or breathe, so he doesn't require much care).
summary: The ability to summon the otherworldly raven to your side
strengths: It can speak, and will gladly follow orders, including spying and giving cryptic knowledge
It can speak with other birds (AND read their minds and emotions) and rally them to fight
It is immortal (can regenerate, and return from death or banishment at will)
weaknesses: He's a smart-alec, so sometimes he may choose not to answer, or answer sarcastically
He doesn't eat, or breathe, but he also doesn't sleep (and he won't leave unless HE wants to)
His knowledge is often cryptic (yes or no questions get you a croaking "NEVERMORE" as a response)

name: Myth Power: Leto's Grace
description: Leto, in Greek myth, was the goddess of motherhood, womanly demure, modesty and concealment. As such, channeling her allows one to turn imperceptible (invisible, intangible, inaudible, inodorous, etc) at will; one does not even leave behind traces of one's presence, such as fingerprints, footprints or the like. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with one's mother at will, as well as withstand any abilities she has. One even gains favor with subjects who have MythPowers.
summary: The ability to channel Leto's command over the essence of motherhood, womanly demure, modesty and concealment
strengths: Turn imperceptible (invisible, etc) at will (may be shared by touch); impossible to track
Psychically perceive and communicate with one's mother at will; immune to her abilities
Favor with people who have MythPowers
weaknesses: Cannot mimic/absorb mother's abilities until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift and MythPower: Artemis' Gift provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and other Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Unfindable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes it nearly impossible to scan for or find the attached power. It also makes itself 'invisible' to an outside searcher to help hide the other power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power nigh impossible to scan for or find
strengths: Now you have a backup the enemy knows nothing about... Hee hee hee hee...
If this power is somehow stolen its last effect is really nice, highly unlikely though
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Mind readers don't have to bother searching, your memories will tell them.

name: Mimesis (Mime Power)
description: Also called Miming, Mime, Pantomime, Pantomimicry or Imitation, this is the ability to mime objects, structures and occurrences into existence by pretending they are happening. By pretending they see something falling out of the sky, a large object of the user's choice (anvil, boulder, a fat lady, etc.) is pulled out of the collective subconscious to pummel the foe. The user can also lean on "nothing", do the infamous "box trick" and the like, but he must conform to the mime "silence rule".
summary: The ability to mime actions, objects and occurrences into existence
strengths: Mime objects (walls, baseball bats) OR occurrences (strong winds, oncoming flood) only you can see
Famous mime abilities (leaning on nothing, the box trick, lassoing) and immunity to sonic attacks
Mimed objects are invisible to everyone except user and people of his choosing (and animals)
weaknesses: Nobody likes mimes
Real mimes get jealous and then you get into miming battles all the time
Speaking, while using this ability, cancels the ability's use temporarily

name: Instant Trip Wire
description: From the tips of your fingers, you can cast thin, nearly invisible wires that can be stuck to any surface and linked to any trap you can think of. For example, you could string one across a hallway and mentally place a cluster of shurikens on the adjacent wall (these will be invisible until triggered). When your target trips the wire, the shurikens will be launched at high speed into them. Wires are unlimited, one trap per wire, and traps can be literally anything you can think of.
summary: The ability to create trip-wires and link them to any trap you can think of.
strengths: Wires are nearly invisible, like spider's web, while traps are completely invisible until triggered.
You can place any trap you can think of.
Wires are indestructible, but disappear after being triggered.
weaknesses: You can trigger your own traps.
in the right light, wires can be seen.
If your target reacts quickly enough, they can potentially escape the traps.

name: Collared
description: Anyone on which the weilder of this power puts a collar, is their slave and the collar can only be taken off by the master or someone they completely and fully trust. This power can only be gained after making 1000 collars from raw materials (e.g. cow hide) by hand.
summary: The ability to make those that you put a collar onto become one's slaves.
strengths: Works on anyone who doesn't have Slavery Immunity or Mimic Slave.
You start off with 1000 collars when you gain this power.
weaknesses: It will take a large amount of time to create 1000 collars.
How in the world are you going to get the raw materials for all those collars?

name: Shadow Life
description: You have the ability to tie your life to a shadow. When the other person dies or object, so do you.
summary: The ability to string your life to another person's shadow.
strengths: Easier to live a long life.
weaknesses: Harder to live a long life.

name: Pit
description: With this power you can cause a pit that is ten feet deep and ten feet wide to appear anywhere on the ground or floor. You can make them appear under an enemy or make one so you can hide in. You cannot get rid of the pits once you create them.
summary: The ability to make pits appear anywhere
strengths: You can make pits appear anywhere
weaknesses: You can't get rid of the pits

name: Sneaky Superpower Snatcher
description: An upgraded version of Power Boomerang. Not only will this power return to you if it is stolen or taken away, but it will also steal some of the thief's powers. Otherwise, it still does nothing and it still is vulnerable to mimicry, destruction, cancellation, etc. But, it still is much better than Power Boomerang, right?
summary: The ability to have this power come back if it is stolen right after it steals some power from the thief.
strengths: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you! Yeah!
It also steals powers from the thief if they steal this power!
If it's cancelled to prevent its return, it will return to you the second the cancellation stops.
weaknesses: What if the thief also has this power and what if you accidentally steal it from them?
It does nothing if it's not stolen or taken away.
It can still be mimicked, deleted or discarded.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Tiger
description: You draw upon the power of the Tiger. You can transform into a tiger, talk with tigers, and move around jungles, forests, and the like wihout making a sound in order to kill your target. This does not help with sneak attacks unless they are to kill.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Tiger
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
Can move around any normally noisy environment without making a sound in order to kill.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the tiger. 1926, 1938, 1950, 1962, 1974, 1986, 1998, 2010, etc.
More of an assassination power.

name: Transformation:Masked Detective
description: The user is able to transform into the mysterious Masked Detective when he or she puts on the overcoat of the first Masked Detective. When the user transforms into the Masked Detective, the user will gain all the knowledge as well as detective skills from previous detectives who use to hold the mantle
summary: The ability to transform into the Masked Detective a detective with an experience of more than a 150 years
strengths: Reduce crime rate
Finish cases faster
Good at finding evidence
weaknesses: Tend to believe in conspiracies more often

name: Detection Detection
description: Ever wondered if someone is using their powers to spy on you? With this power, you can sense when someone is using powers to obtain information about subjects within 25 kilometers of you. At first you only know when it is happening, but with practice you can detect users, acquired information, locations of users, powers used and more.
summary: The ability to detect detection powers.
strengths: Know when being spied upon with powers.
Large area of effect.
Works on targets no matter the range, provided they use a power within your effective range.
weaknesses: Less useful when inexperienced.
Information may not be useful to you.
Only affects detection powers; not other powers.

name: No Scent
description: With this you have no scent. Without this power the best that a person can do is try to mask their scent which doesn't always work in terms of hiding or tracking. The character, Kanna, in the manga, Inuyasha, has this power. It is in book 16 page 29.
summary: The ability to have no scent whatsoever
strengths: Can't be tracked by scent.
Never smell bad with this power.
Scent-based powers that make you smell a certain way have no effect on you.
weaknesses: Never smell good while having this power.
Can still be affected by other people's scents.

name: The Sneaker Sneaked
description: The passive part of the power makes you aware of anyone who is sneaking up on you. You then have the choice to use the active part of the power, which is to sneak up on that person. It can happen in two ways. If they lost sight of you at that moment, you will be teleported in their blind spot, allowing you to sneak up on them. If they were watching you, your doppelganger takes your place while you are teleported and sneak up on them. You can decide if you want to appear far from or near them.
summary: The ability to sneak up on someone who is sneaking up on you.
strengths: Noone can ever sneak up on you by surprise.
It's creepy to follow someone from afar and they are suddenly right behind your back.
You are guaranteed to appear somewhere they can't see you, usually behind them.
weaknesses: If you use this power to sneak up on a sneaker and they also use it to sneak up on you.
If you don't have the means to attack or defend yourself, it could be dangerous to sneak up on them.

name: Taboo
description: The user of this power is able to trap their enemies in a special gourd if their enemies says their most frequent word or phrase once they are hit by a special golden rope attached on the user's arm . Enemies who figure out this power and remain silent, meaning they do not talk , will also be dragged into the gourd after 5 minutes . An enemy will be able to escape if he or she changes their frequent word to another word
summary: The ability to trap a person within a special gourd if he or she says their most frequent word
strengths: Most people dont know what their frequent word is
Can trap the people in the gourd indefinitely
weaknesses: Hard to touch people with the golden rope
People who know their favorite and think before they speak may be able to escape

name: Ghost Of Dogs
description: Share space with a Dog of Existence. You have the ability to see & physically effect all forms & planes of existence. Pseudo-existent the Dog moves at sublight speeds precognitively reacting for you in an instant. Snatch people out of the Astral plane. Punch pure energy & intangibles. Eat shadows. His agenda is to defeat and consume all shadow & dark powers. A side effect of sharing space with the Dog you become a Werewolf. The Dog mastered combat in the past, present & future. Now, so have you.
summary: The ability to merge with Dog of Existence
strengths: You are master of every weapon & martial art in the past, present and future
forced to be a werewolf merged with a semi-visible paranormal super-wolf in your own image
The Ghost of Dogs is always watching your back, it never rests or sleeps
weaknesses: You cause a fight or flight reaction in all creatures. Including average & below average IQ humans
You eat grass to heal; eat horses & cows to live & pesky hard to control heightened senses
Eating normal shadows KO's a human. Eating dark/shadow powered people gives you their filthy powers.

name: Author Power Negation
description: Annoyed at people abusing the power you made? Are they bringing them out of the context you intended? If so, this power is definitely for you. With this power, you can eliminate a particular instance of it. For instance, if you were using Form Replication, the author could stop you from changing/acquiring alternate forms, but still let you change between your disguise and normal form easily, or vice versa.
summary: The ability to negate select instances of the powers you created.
strengths: Stop abuse of the powers you made.
The creator of this power does not intend to use it to harm others, so you are safe.
You can negate a power in the normal fashion (but it takes more effort)
weaknesses: Cannot be altered by other powers. Thus, you cannot eliminate this con or other cons.
Useless to those who have not submitted powers to the superpower list.
Useless against powers you didn't create.

name: Spydyr's Door
description: Thanks to Shadowulf1 and Josh for this idea. With this power, you are able to leave any place in style. No matter what you are doing or being done to, you will be able to exit in the coolest way ever.
summary: The ability to leave an area in a grand exit
strengths: Able to impress the ladies
Your reputation will be huge
Leaving in style
weaknesses: No offense whatsoever
Always have to leave first to make that good impression.
Leaving a public bathroom could get awkward.......

name: Shadowulf1 Tamer
description: Shadowulf has a lot of powers, a LOT of powers that he created,so with this power you will be able to have all of his MYTHPOWER superpowers and more, XD
summary: The ability to own every single power Shadowulf1 has or will create
strengths: A lot of powers
Hes a very good power creator, (Claps twice)
weaknesses: This power might not be published :(
He might not make a good one for a while

name: Idiot Minion Field
description: This power turns minions or henchpersons into klutzy morons. The radius is one mile. A sniper henchman won't be able shoot you as he'll forget the gun safety is on. Henchmen with guns will shoot themselves in the feet. Sneak into a foe's lair and just keep telling each henchman or minion that sees you,"I'm the janitor" or "I'm your boss disguised as my worst enemy. "
summary: The ability to turn all evil human minions/henchpersons into klutzy morons.
strengths: The mile radius of the power should cover most villain bases.
A power that makes henchmen forget to check if the gun safety is on.
weaknesses: Some villains have non-human minions.
Klutzy and dumb people get lucky and kill someone by mistake.

name: Arcana 13: Death
description: At any point in time, you may die. Upon your death, you become an intangible, invisible spirit creature and maintain all of your normal powers. At any time following your death, you may chose to return to a physical life. Your new body is any age of your choosing. However, your new body is always slightly different from your old one, with variations in appearance, ethnicity and even gender. You may also suffer from mental changes, though you maintain your basic personality.
summary: The ability to take an early death.
strengths: You can avoid attacks by simply dying.
Death is mostly an inconvience for you.
You can spy on or enter contained areas as a spirit.
weaknesses: While in spirit form, abilities and attacks that affect spirits or souls will affect you.
Using this ability often can result in extreme changes in physical form and personality.
You may have difficulty with psychopomps and other creatures of death.

name: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
description: If you have to sleep next to someone who snores loudly, you can turn their snoring into holographic imitative words like 'Zzzzzzz' (or 'Kkhhh', if you have to sleep next to Donald Duck). They will be silent and fun to watch.
summary: The ability to turn snoring into holographic imitative words.
strengths: No more sleepless nights beside a snoring partner.
Surely the last power on the list.
Fun to watch.
weaknesses: Other unpleasant noises can still keep you awake.

name: Flower Mimicry (Flower Form)
description: You can become a flower whenever you want to. This form can last as long as you want, and happens almost instantly. And you are very convincing as a flower.
summary: The ability to become a flower.
strengths: You can hide easily.
You are pretty.
weaknesses: As a flower, you can't talk or move, and you can be controlled by Agrokinesis
You might get trampled (you ARE just a flower)
Bugs always trying to pollinate you...

name: Lo Z: Majora's Mask Of Revenge
description: This is a mask when put on allows you to transform into any of the Zelda Dungeon main bosses.... This can span any of the zelda games. This means you could transform into someone like Fyrus, Stallord, or Blizzeta from Twilight Princess to someone older like Volvagia or King Dodongo or Bongo Bongo
summary: The ability to transform into any Zelda Dungeon Final Boss
strengths: You gain their powers and strengths
You can transform into a monster

name: Viral Saliva
description: With this ability, oral contact can be fatal. You can sneak a sip from a foe's drink, and they'll go home terminally ill. You can betray foes with a literal kiss of death. Spitting on someone, kissing, even sneezing and coughing, can result in the spread of a deathly-powerful virus regardless of whether the user is sick or not.
summary: The ability to be host to a deadly virus, carried through the saliva
strengths: Easily sicken enemies
Symptoms manifest fast
Each user of this ability is host to a different virus
weaknesses: Sometimes this power can't be suppressed (no more kissing)
People immune to disease, or who can rapidly regenerate
People who can cure disease

name: Third Amendment
description: Whenever a soldier tries to enter your home, they are flung back five feet away by an invisible force.
